mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_chat_message(conversation_id, sequence_no, role, content, status, source_kb_ids, model_name, error_message, qa_record_id, completed_at) VALUES(#{conversationId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, CAST(#{sourceKbIds} AS bigint[]), #{modelName}, #{errorMessage}, #{qaRecordId}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) + 1 FROM kb_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_chat_message SET content = #{content}, status = 'COMPLETED', retrieved_chunk_ids = CAST(#{chunkIds} AS bigint[]), model_name = #{modelName}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, qa_record_id = #{qaRecordId}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{messageId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT role, content FROM kb_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND role IN ('USER', 'ASSISTANT') ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
